feed.title: NPR Topics: Science
feed.subtitle: The latest health and science news. Updates on medicine, healthy living, nutrition, drugs, diet, and advances in science and technology. Subscribe to the Health & Science podcast.

entry.title: 'It's a nightmare.' Former refugee, professor on Trump's new Medicaid policy
entry.summary: Starting Oct. 1, many immigrants who are here legally lose their Medicaid coverage because of the Republican budget bill passed last year.

entry.title: Google launches Project Suncatcher, a step towards AI data centers in space
entry.summary: The fridge-size satellite with AI chips on board is part of Project Suncatcher, the company's moonshot effort to put AI data centers in space and harness solar energy.

entry.title: New space station crew launches from Florida on SpaceX's Crew Dragon capsule
entry.summary: The crew of four — two NASA astronauts, one from Canada, and a Russian cosmonaut — heads to the International Space Station after liftoff from the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida.

entry.title: A startup wants to build a massive nuclear-powered data center on public land in Utah
entry.summary: Valar Atomics wants to place over 450 reactors on more than 9,500 acres in Utah to power a huge data center project.

entry.title: Drugs are widely used to sedate dementia patients. Her sons wanted to keep her off them
entry.summary: Potent sedating medications are often used on agitated people with dementia in long-term care facilities despite federal efforts to discourage them. A clash over whether to drug a Michigan woman illuminates the wrenching decisions families and guardians face.

entry.title: Historic science museum in Philadelphia to close
entry.summary: Philadelphia's Academy of Natural Sciences is set to close down thanks to financial pressures. The 198-year-old museum houses important scientific specimens and a beloved dinosaur exhibit.

entry.title: This year's MacArthur Fellows include researchers who fuse science and justice
entry.summary: The MacArthur Foundation has just announced its latest batch of 20 fellows. Among the recipients of the $800,000 "no-strings-attached" fellowships are researchers who were recognized for their work at the intersection of science and justice.

entry.title: Meet the 20 scholars and artists who've just won MacArthur Fellowships
entry.summary: A historian who studies wage gaps between races and a saxophonist whose live performances include a chef are among the latest recipients of the philanthropic group's annual, no-strings-attached $800,000 grants.

entry.title: The Trump administration weakens fuel efficiency standards for new cars
entry.summary: The Trump administration says easing these standards will make cars more affordable. Critics say it's not so simple and could be costly for the environment.

entry.title: SpaceX's Starship launches on first orbital mission from Texas
entry.summary: Starship is key to SpaceX's commercial success and NASA's plans to land humans on the moon. This is the 14th flight of the uncrewed Starship, but the first time it reached orbit.
